pretreatments.description: Alkaline pretreatment using NaOH solutions (0.2%, 0.4%, 0.6%, and 0.8% w/v) at 37°C for 3 hours, performed in 500 mL Pyrex glass bottles with 350 mL working volume. The specific alkali doses ranged from 2 g NaOH/100 g TS_sludge to 8 g NaOH/100 g TS_sludge, followed by pH neutralization to 7 using 0.02 N H2SO4.

Photocatalytic pretreatment using titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles (0.3, 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6 g/L) irradiated under continuous UV-B lamps (320 nm, 100 W) for 3 hours at 37°C in 1 L beakers with 600 mL working volume. TiO2 NPs were synthesized from anatase grade TiO2 powder and crushed into a clear crystalline form.

Combined alkaline-photocatalytic pretreatment where the doses of NaOH from Section 2.3 were combined with the doses of TiO2 NPs from Section 2.4. Pretreatment conditions (temperature, time, stirring speed, and volume) remained the same as individual pretreatments.
